CustomConnection.description:
User-defined contact method with custom icon and URL.

Why:
    Built-in social networks cover common platforms, but users need
    arbitrary contact methods (personal websites, custom platforms).
    CustomConnection provides a FontAwesome icon, display text, and
    optional URL for any contact channel.
CustomConnection.title: CustomConnection

Cv.description:
The content of a CV: who you are, and what you did.

Why:
    Content is independent of the design and of the entry types' looks.
    The header fields are fixed; sections hold entries of any entry type
    declared in Typst.

email.description: You can provide multiple emails as a list.
email.title: Email

photo.description: Photo file path (relative to the YAML file) or a URL.
photo.title: Photo

phone.description: Your phone number with country code in international format (e.g., +1 for USA, +44 for UK). You can provide multiple numbers as a list.
phone.title: Phone

website.description: You can provide multiple URLs as a list.
website.title: Website

custom_connections.description: Additional header connections you define yourself. Each item has a `placeholder` (the displayed text), an optional `url`, and the Font Awesome icon name to render (from https://fontawesome.com/search).
custom_connections.title: Custom Connections

sections.description: The sections of your CV. Keys are section titles (e.g., Experience, Education), and values are lists of entries, or mappings of subsection titles to lists of entries. Entry types are detected from their fields.

Cv.title: Cv

Locale.description:
The words and formats of the CV's language.

Why:
    Dates, "present", and phrases like "PhD in Computer Science" depend on
    the language. Choosing a built-in language fills in all of them;
    anything can still be changed, and any language can be defined.

language.description: The language of the CV. Choosing a built-in language fills in all other fields; for another language, provide all fields.
language.title: Language

iso_code.description: The language's ISO 639 code, like `en` or `de`. Used for hyphenation and accessibility.
iso_code.title: Iso Code

direction.description: The writing direction: `ltr` (left to right) or `rtl`.
direction.title: Direction

Locale.title: Locale

Phrases.description: Phrases that combine several fields, in the locale's word order.

degree_with_area.description: How a degree and a field of study are written together, as Typst markup where `#degree` and `#area` are the two fields. For example, `"#degree in #area"` writes "PhD in Computer Science".
degree_with_area.title: Degree With Area

Phrases.title: Phrases

output_folder.description: Base output folder for all generated files. The default value is `rendercv_output`. Referenced as `OUTPUT_FOLDER` in output path defaults.

design.description: Path to the Typst file that defines the design, relative to the input YAML file. The default is `design.typ` next to the YAML file if it exists, otherwise the classic design.

entries.description: Path to the Typst file that defines the entry types, relative to the input YAML file. The default is `entries.typ` next to the YAML file if it exists, otherwise the standard entry types.

locale.description: Path to a YAML file containing the `locale` field.

typst_path.description:
Output path for the Typst file, relative to the input YAML file. The default value is `OUTPUT_FOLDER/NAME_IN_SNAKE_CASE_CV.typ`.

The following placeholders can be used:

- OUTPUT_FOLDER: The output folder path (e.g., rendercv_output)
- MONTH_NAME: Full name of the month (e.g., January)
- MONTH_ABBREVIATION: Abbreviation of the month (e.g., Jan)
- MONTH: Month as a number (e.g., 1)
- MONTH_IN_TWO_DIGITS: Month as a number in two digits (e.g., 01)
- DAY: Day of the month (e.g., 5)
- DAY_IN_TWO_DIGITS: Day of the month in two digits (e.g., 05)
- YEAR: Year as a number (e.g., 2024)
- YEAR_IN_TWO_DIGITS: Year as a number in two digits (e.g., 24)
- NAME: The name of the CV owner (e.g., John Doe)
- NAME_IN_SNAKE_CASE: The name of the CV owner in snake case (e.g., John_Doe)
- NAME_IN_LOWER_SNAKE_CASE: The name of the CV owner in lower snake case (e.g., john_doe)
- NAME_IN_UPPER_SNAKE_CASE: The name of the CV owner in upper snake case (e.g., JOHN_DOE)
- NAME_IN_KEBAB_CASE: The name of the CV owner in kebab case (e.g., John-Doe)
- NAME_IN_LOWER_KEBAB_CASE: The name of the CV owner in lower kebab case (e.g., john-doe)
- NAME_IN_UPPER_KEBAB_CASE: The name of the CV owner in upper kebab case (e.g., JOHN-DOE)

pdf_title.description:
Title metadata for the PDF document. This appears in browser tabs and PDF readers. Available placeholders:
- `NAME`: The CV owner's name from `cv.name`
- `CURRENT_DATE`: The month abbreviation and year (e.g., Jan 2025)
- `MONTH_NAME`: Full month name (e.g., January)
- `MONTH_ABBREVIATION`: Abbreviated month name (e.g., Jan)
- `MONTH`: Month number (e.g., 1)
- `MONTH_IN_TWO_DIGITS`: Zero-padded month (e.g., 01)
- `DAY`: Day of the month (e.g., 5)
- `DAY_IN_TWO_DIGITS`: Zero-padded day (e.g., 05)
- `YEAR`: Full year (e.g., 2025)
- `YEAR_IN_TWO_DIGITS`: Two-digit year (e.g., 25)

The default value is `NAME - CV`.
pdf_title.title: PDF Title
